title: Display output much darker with Linux 7.2.2
body: Ever since upgrading to kernel to 7.2.2 I've noticed that the display output has become considerably darker, causing many darker details to be lost when for example viewing video content. This only shows up on this display itself, not in screenshots taken with Plasma's screenshot app. This system is using a Vega 64 with amdgpu (see full output of lspcie below), connected directly to a Sony TV using HDMI and running latest KDE Plasma. The issue is most visible in SDR mode but the HDR image seems to darken as well however nowhere near as much as with SDR (see the comparison screenshots below). Rolling back to linux-7.1.11-arch1-1 (and headers) fixes the issue. Anyone have any idea what could be going on here?
